<?hh

namespace Demo;

newtype UserId = int;

async function greet(string $name, int $times = 1): Awaitable<string> {
  $text = "Hello, $name!\n";
  $names = vec['ann', 'bob'];
  $ages = dict['ann' => 30];
  await \HH\Asio\usleep(10);
  return \str_repeat($text, $times);
}

function shape_of(): shape('x' => int, 'y' => float) {
  return shape('x' => 0x1F, 'y' => 1.5);
}
